name: Prescribed-Subset Ordering Width
definition: For a nonempty subset $I\subseteq C$, minimize the ordinary ordering width over all orders of $C$ whose first $|I|$ concepts are exactly the members of $I$; their internal ordering is also optimized and its cost is included.
parameters: A finite nonempty binary class $C$ and nonempty prescribed initial subset $I\subseteq C$.
normalization: No order within $I$ is prescribed; $\sigma(C;C)=\sigma(C)$ and $\sigma(C;I)\geq\max\{\sigma(C),\sigma(I)\}$.
